jobs.title: Pricing & Packaging Ops Manager - Contractor
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.





 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Project manage execution of the P&P rollout: track workstreams across IT/Systems, Sales Enablement, Deal Desk, CX, Finance and Legal, and flag risks before they slip.

 - Build and maintain internal-facing pricing artifacts: enablement decks, FAQ docs, rollout timelines, and training materials for Sales and CS.

 - Manage the build process for external-facing pricing collateral (pricing pages, one-pagers, sales guides)

 - Partner with Deal Desk and Systems on CPQ configuration, SKU bundling, and contract updates: translate pricing decisions into implementation requirements.

 - Conduct competitive pricing and packaging research: monitor competitor moves, pull public pricing data, and synthesize findings into clear comparisons, not raw notes.

 - Support pricing analysis: pull and organize data for ASP, win rate, and deal size questions, and flag patterns worth a closer look.

 - Manage the pilot testing process: recruit pilot accounts, track feedback, synthesize results into a go/no-go recommendation.



What success looks like:

 - Rollout stays on schedule. Slip risks are anticipated and escalated early with alternatives identified; stakeholders feel heard, managed and know what they own and are accountable for; verbal and written communication is clear and unambiguous.

 - Competitive intel is current and gets used, not filed away. You know where you stand before a pricing decision, not after.

 - Sales needs are anticipated, and enablement materials ship on time so they can be used without follow-up questions.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years in pricing, sales/GTM operations, or strategy consulting, with direct exposure to SaaS pricing and packaging.

 - Can run a competitive pricing scan or a basic ASP analysis independently and know what's worth flagging.

 - Experience at a pricing consulting firm, or hands-on experience leading a pricing or packaging redesign at a platform or data products company.

 - Strong project manager skills: direct, succinct communicator; can anticipate what is missing from plans; recommend prioritization and tradeoffs; drives stakeholder ownership, accountability and task closure; .

 - Comfortable working across Product, Sales, Finance, IT and Legal without a formal reporting line into any of them and with .

 - Clear written communicator. Can turn a messy set of inputs into a clean status update or decision doc.

 - Bias for action. Default is to move things forward, not wait for perfect information. 

 


HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).




Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is seeking an experienced customer-facing Global Program Manager (GPM) to oversee the post-sale experience for our largest Enterprise customers. The GPM will partner closely with the Enterprise Account Executive to ensure that customers achieve rapid time to value and see the value in expanding their relationship with Benchling as they transform and modernize their R&D IT. The GPM will coordinate implementation, customer success, and customer support efforts to ensure customers have a seamless experience post-sale.


The GPM must have deep experience in Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts as well as operating in an enterprise SaaS environment and be adept at working with internal and external stakeholders at all levels.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Oversee post-sale activities across implementation, support, customer success, and optimization services for one or more more Enterprise customers

 - Partner with customer leaders and Benchling account teams to develop implementation, governance, change management, risk management, escalation management, adoption, and success plans that accelerate customer digital transformations

 - Liaise with customer leaders and be known as a diplomatic, pragmatic partner, who operates with sense of urgency to effect a best in class customer experience

 - Partner with the Enterprise AE to ensure seamless customer experience and grow the account

 - Support the development of customer experience sales proposals and other services proposals with account, and/or program subject matter expertise

 - Coordinate all Professional Services, Customer Success and Support activities to drive customer value, adoption, and advocacy

 - Partner with Product Management to maintain strategic engagement and alignment of customer needs with product roadmap

 - You will help shape the long-term strategy and vision for the Enterprise services business

 - You will inspire your cross-functional account team to accelerate our growth within the world’s largest biopharma companies by delivering exceptional customer experiences

 - You will be seen as a trusted advisor who has the customer’s best interests in mind, even when it means having a hard conversation

 - You will mentor, coach, and champion your cross-functional account team as you help them grow their professional skills

 - You will contribute meaningfully to running a profitable services business that doesn’t sacrifice quality or customer success in doing so

 - You will be a respected cross-functional partner to our Sales, Solutions, and Product teams, known for fairly advocating for both the customer and for Benchling

 


QUALIFICATIONS

Must haves:

 - Passionate about and experience working with Life Sciences companies with an understanding of R&D processes and scientific concepts. Must be able to confidently engage and build trust with scientific, informatics, IT, and Director/VP level audiences in top-20 Biotech and Pharma companies.

 - You are accountable and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment. You have strong executive presence and succeed in a matrixed environment where you have accountability without authority.

 - At least 10+ years client facing implementation, program leadership and/or consulting experience, with demonstrated record of successfully running large scale programs, ideally in the Life Sciences or Biotechnology sponsor or software space.

 - Proven ability to lead large cross-functional post-sale teams to deliver transformational change with superior relationship, project management, organizational, and commercial skills.  This includes work across professional services, customer support, customer success, product, marketing, strategy, and sales.

 - Experienced in program and project management for multi-workstream enterprise SaaS deployments including scope management, budget control, project and executive reporting, and project financials.

 - Experience in services commercials including SOWs, budgeting, resourcing, and change orders.

 - Excellent interpersonal skills in verbal, written and presentation formats and experience presenting to the C-suite.

 - Ability to work at customer site, or in the Boston office based on customer and project needs.

 - BS or advanced degree in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering or similar life science field preferred, or equivalent professional experience working with Life Sciences R&D processes and/or healthcare technology.

Nice to have:

 - GxP experience including software validation (CSV) at a life sciences or biotech company and/or vertical SaaS software company.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As the Customer Experience Communications Operations Manager at Benchling, you will own the communications backbone for our customer base. Benchling ships product updates every day on a continuous release model, and we operate in regulated, validated customer environments where clear and appropriately timed product messaging directly translates to compliance rigor and customer trust. This role makes sure that when something changes, breaks, or ships, there is a defined, well-run process that gets the right message to the right customers on time.

You will own three connected streams: incident communications, where you are accountable for the coverage, quality, and timeliness of what customers hear; change and release communications, where you own a single intake and a tiering system that sizes every change to the right message, audience, channel, and timing; and communications performance, where you own the operating model, dashboards, and retros that tell us whether the system is working and what to fix. You will report to the Leader of CX Operations.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the incident communications framework: the severity model, playbooks, approved templates, and structure that let any qualified team send accurate customer comms at any hour.

 - Hold accountability for coverage, quality, timeliness, and contractual notification windows across all external incident communications, and keep delivery auditable.

 - Run a single intake for all customer comms requests (betas, announcements, releases, breaking and disruptive changes) and own the tiering system that sizes each change to the right audience, channel mix, and timing.

 - Build and maintain the approved template library so CX teams can send consistent, on-brand messaging on demand without routing every request through Operations.

 - Administer and improve the tooling that customer comms run through, and partner with the teams that own our integrations and automation across our tooling stack

 - Own the dashboards and reporting that show what is in flight, how fast it went out, and how it landed, and present performance and trends to CX leadership.

 - Run comms-lens post-incident reviews and drive the systemic fixes they surface with Product, Engineering, and Support.

 - Own the RACI across CX, Product, and Marketing for each comms type

 


QUALIFICATIONS

Requirements

 - 8+ years in customer communications operations, incident or change management, or a comparable operations role in B2B SaaS, ideally at a continuous-release software company.

 - Track record of building tiered, repeatable processes, clear RACIs, and performance dashboards.

 - Experience getting results through other teams: you define the standard, enable the people who execute it, and hold the bar without absorbing the work yourself.

 - Editorial judgment strong enough to set the bar for others. You can read a draft about a dense technical change or an unfolding incident and tell whether it is clear, accurate, and appropriately scoped for a busy scientific audience.

 - Comfort operating against contractual notification obligations and in regulated or validated customer environments.

 - Hands-on experience across a modern customer stack, for example Salesforce, Zendesk, Gainsight, a status or incident tool, BI and reporting tools, and email or marketing automation.

 - You use AI tools in your daily work and actively look for ways to apply them to comms triage, drafting, audience targeting, and performance analysis.

Bonus if you have:

 - A background in the life sciences or hands-on experience with scientific R&D workflows, enough to tell a low-risk product change from one that meaningfully changes how a lab works.

 - Experience standing up or administering comms tooling such as lifecycle or email orchestration, in-app messaging, or status page platforms.

 - SQL or hands-on reporting skills for building comms and incident trend dashboards.

 - Prior experience in a customer-facing role (CSM, TAM, Support, Implementation) or familiarity with Benchling's product.

This role sits at the intersection of finance, strategy, and company execution.  - Create executive and Board reporting that turns financial and operating data into clear insights, risks, and recommended actions.

 - Establish performance frameworks and operating rhythms that connect company goals, financial plans, and business results.

 - Partner with Accounting and functional finance leaders to ensure forecasts and management reporting are accurate, consistent, and decision-useful.

 - Lead and develop a high-performing strategic finance team that can scale with the company.

 - Deep fluency in SaaS business models and the metrics that drive durable growth, retention, and operating efficiency.

 - Experience supporting a company through significant scale, business-model evolution, or preparation for the public markets.

 - A tech-forward mindset that enthusiastically explores new tools and processes as means to improve business insight and team experience.

 - Led company-wide planning, forecasting, and long-range modeling in partnership with executives and functional leaders.

 - Track record of influencing major business decisions through clear analysis, strong judgment, and business acumen.

 - Moves from complex financial and operational data to a concise narrative and a clear recommendation.

 - Effective executive communicator who is comfortable presenting to senior leadership and Boards.

 - Builds strong relationships across functions and can challenge assumptions while maintaining trust.

Partner for Impact

Benchling is looking for a Head of Procurement to lead how we buy. You'll be a senior individual contributor reporting to the Chief Accounting Officer with broad influence across and responsibility for our third-party spend in cloud infrastructure, enterprise SaaS, and professional services, and over our travel and expense program.

Our procurement function has earned real trust across the business. Teams don't just invite procurement into their deals for compliance, but because it makes their deals better. You'll protect and build on that trust. You'll be a partner to the business: someone who understands what each team is trying to achieve, looks objectively through a broader company-wide lens, finds the best overall value for Benchling, and makes buying easier while improving how it's controlled.

You'll lead negotiations of our largest and most strategic contracts, build coverage to address the tail, and be our expert on what a well-designed procure-to-pay process looks like, guiding our systems and accounting partners toward it.  You'll work closely with Engineering, IT, Security, Marketing, Legal, Strategic Finance, Corporate Development, and Accounting, running a regular rhythm that gets to decisions. You'll adjust how involved you are to what each team needs, from running a deal end to end to coaching an experienced owner.

 - Enhance our renewal management process, building a renewal strategy with business owners and Strategic Finance, so renewal pricing never comes as a surprise.

 - Develop category strategies for our major spend areas, and use them to consolidate vendors, inform renewal strategies and stop redundant software spend, working with business partners on usage monitoring and build-versus-buy decisions.

 - Design and implement an appropriately sized third-party vendor risk program that aligns and partners with security and other stakeholders.  Improve vendor risk visibility and build mitigation plans with business partners.

 - Build leverage by giving business owners what they need to negotiate on their own.

 - Advise on categories outside procurement today, such as benefits, large events, real estate, and our contingent workforce vendors.
   
   

Process excellence

 - Own our procurement and T&E policies, set clear rules for when procurement gets involved, and assess whether our tools are still the right ones.

 - Simplify and apply AI and automation from intake through reporting, including procurement metrics teams can use on their own, department-level tool budgets with Strategic Finance, and tracking of committed and usage-based contracts with Corporate Accounting.
